entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a Returns Specialist now.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been trying to return this useless VeloBand Pulse for two days and your website is a joke. I want my money back, now!
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. Could I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Karen Thompson, order number VF88-12059. Don't waste my time, Alex. I expect this to be handled.
Thank you, Karen. I'm pulling up your account now. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand Pulse? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

The issue is that I don't want it and your company makes it impossible to return! I tried two days ago and got a massive `website error`. The whole thing crashed and I `couldn't print` the label. I want a manager. This is ridiculous.

I understand your frustration, Karen, and I do apologize for the trouble with our site. We were experiencing some technical difficulties. Let me see what I can do for you personally without needing to escalate.
You'd better. It felt like your whole `system` was `down`. I even took a `screenshot` of the error page! If this isn't resolved on this call, I'm posting it everywhere.

That won't be necessary. I see you're one of our VIP members, and I can confirm there was a known outage that day which would have caused the issue you described. Looking at your delivery date... yes, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you right now.
Oh. So you're actually going to do your job? Fine. Send me the label.
Of course. And for the inconvenience caused by our website, I'd like to add a $50 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchases. Again, my sincere apologies for the frustrating experience.
Well... okay. A $50 credit? That's... acceptable. Thank you, Alex. I appreciate you fixing this.

It's my pleasure, Karen. I've just emailed the pre-paid return label to you. Simply print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. The $50 credit is active on your account immediately. Is there anything else I can help with?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
